definition.method: Execute stochastic perturbation simulation with coupling parameter 0.998 across three independent random seeds to measure variance in resultant values.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    params = inputs.get('parameters', {})
    seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [190, 380, 570])
    random.seed(seeds[0])
    coupling = params.get('coupling', 0.998)
    vals1 = [random.random() * coupling for _ in range(120)]
    vals2 = [random.random() * coupling for _ in range(120)]
    divergence = [abs(v1 - v2) for v1, v2 in zip(vals1, vals2)]
    mean_delta = sum(divergence) / len(divergence)
    return {'divergence_variance_delta': mean_delta}
definition.stop: Terminate if divergence variance delta is measured for the specified seeds.
